scope: Exact amplitude compensation and exact exponentials. Lean derives H(t)>= min(1,exp(2t))*min(1,hbar)*C^{-1}/2 for every finite capacity and all states, with nonnegative potential coefficients and hbar>=0. Positive hbar and the proved energy-growth bound give inverse-clock expectation control with no boundary-tail assumption. Constants degenerate as hbar tends to zero. Occupation/momentum propagation, operator domains and convergence, physical identification and a TOE remain unproved.
